name: dynamic-grid
title: Dynamic Grid
description: A responsive animated grid background driven by CSS variables for SaaS, code, and data scenes. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="dynamic-grid": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Density
variables.description: Cell size of the grid: fine reads as graph paper, coarse as a few large panels.

variables.label: Weight
variables.description: Thickness of the grid lines, from a hairline rule to a bold structural grid.

variables.label: Tone
variables.description: Line colour: neutral is the translucent text colour, brand the brand red of the reel.
